gates.name: finite_digest_bound_catalogue
gates.evidence: Closed catalogue, adapter and action schemas normalize the exact two synthetic adapters/actions; adapter/action/resource/field/effect/method/path/version sets are finite and the normalized catalogue digest is stable under safe reordering.

gates.name: per_action_evidence_and_non_claims
gates.evidence: Each inactive descriptor exposes exact catalogue/adapter versions and digests, action digest, closed surface, local evidence reference, compatibility set and all three required provenance/activation non-claims.

gates.name: inactive_by_default_semantics
gates.evidence: Admission and exact inspection both retain decision DENY; inspection is descriptive and non-executable, and no Policy decision, approval, authority, credential, provider call, callback, URL, header or activation token is emitted.

gates.name: adversarial_and_regression_evidence
gates.evidence: Unknown/duplicate adapter/action, incompatible version, malformed digest/evidence, altered non-claims, active-state injection, open field/resource/path and tampered admission/inspection bindings deny closed.

fullDemoInstallSmoke.reason: AAS-012 changes a pure TypeScript contract, tests and public closure only; no runtime, installer, Compose, provider-adapter or install-path byte changed. The completed AAS-016 SAFE_DEMO_COLD-02 remains the one relevant frozen-byte smoke and the durable smoke budget forbids an unrelated repeat.

correctingEvidence.defect: The first mechanical checksum rewrite included the isolated worktree .git pointer, then a retry observed generated Python cache files after video tests.
correctingEvidence.correction: The checksum closure now excludes the .git control file, node_modules, dist, development evidence and generated __pycache__/pyc files; the exact 129-file closure passes.
correctingEvidence.scope: Evidence-path bytes only; no contract, runtime, install or test behavior changed, so only affected checksum and supply-chain checks were repeated.
